g.title: cluster_cli
g.text: Client SDK (catalog-service-client jar — reused by callers)

g.title: Svc
g.text: Pass-through over the ports (DIP); no business logic — replaces CatalogEJB

g.title: Dtos
g.text: Additive-safe: add a field w/o breaking callers

g.title: PortSearch
g.text: Segregated search port — swap in a search engine w/o touching browse

g.title: Jpa
g.text: DEFAULT adapter — implements BOTH ports over H2/JPA

g.title: SearchImpl
g.text: Dynamic token count -> StringBuilder JPQL; attrs NOT searched

g.title: Mongo
g.text: OPT-IN adapter — implements BOTH ports over MongoDB

g.title: Client
g.text: Reused by storefront & other callers — no URL/JSON leaks
